title: Painting & decorating service page for GB Fixit Handyman…
brief: Painting & decorating service page for GB Fixit Handyman Services, Dundee (URL /painters-decorators-dundee). SEO focus: "painters and decorators dundee" (H1 "Painters and decorators in Dundee"); supporting "decorator dundee", "painter dundee", "exterior painting dundee". Must link back to the homepage with anchor text "handyman in Dundee". Page content (real, from the approved copy): intro "Kris and Gary paint and decorate homes across Dundee, Broughty Ferry, Monifieth and Carnoustie, inside and out. You get a written quote that sets out each step, the work starts and finishes when we say, and the house is left tidy at the end of every day." Typical jobs: full room redecoration (walls, ceilings, doors, skirting, frames); wallpapering and stripping incl. feature and mural walls; gloss, satinwood, staining and varnishing on doors, banisters and handrails; exterior painting: roughcast, wooden windows and doors, fascias; metalwork: balconies and downpipes wire-brushed and repainted; paint stripping and prep on older woodwork. Recent jobs: roughcast exterior repainted (DD6, Sep 2025); living room and master bedroom redecorated, new skirting, mural wallpaper hung (Dundee, Jun 2026); all wooden windows and doors repainted plus metal balcony (DD6, Jun 2023); kitchen and bathroom painted incl. ceilings and frames (Dundee DD2, Nov 2022); living room fully decorated while owners on holiday (Dundee DD3, Aug 2022); five old metal downpipes prepared and repainted (Dundee DD2, Aug 2022). Reviews: "Everything was done to a high standard and they started and finished when they said." (Pam, Reference Line, Dec 2025); "You would never had known that there had been a tradesman in the house." (Reference Line, Dundee, Nov 2022); "We went on holiday while the work was being done, it was such a delight to return to find everything finished." (Reference Line, Dundee, Aug 2022). FAQs: Do you paint outside as well as inside? / Can you hang wallpaper? / Can the work be done while we are away? / How do quotes work? Ratings 9.8/10 from 59 Reference Line reviews, 5.0 from 35 Google reviews, Dundee Trusted Trader. Quote form + Kris 07740 443180, kris@gbfixit.co.uk. Use the same header/footer and nav as the new homepage. Photos are labelled placeholders.
designSystemName: Design System Inspired by GB Fixit

directions.label: Classic hero + feature grid
directions.summary: The familiar, scannable marketing layout: one clear promise above the fold, then evidence in a grid.
directions.spec:
### Classic hero + feature grid  `(id: classic-hero-grid)`

The familiar, scannable marketing layout: one clear promise above the fold, then evidence in a grid.

**Cues:**
- split hero: headline and primary action on one side, product visual on the other
- a 3- or 4-column feature grid directly below, icon or small visual per cell
- one social-proof strip (logos or a single quote) between sections

**Must differ:** Hero is a two-column split and the key section is a uniform grid; siblings must not use a split hero or a uniform card grid.

directions.label: Story-led long scroll
directions.summary: A narrative page that earns attention section by section, like an editorial feature.
directions.spec:
### Story-led long scroll  `(id: story-led-scroll)`

A narrative page that earns attention section by section, like an editorial feature.

**Cues:**
- full-width, centred, type-led hero with an oversized headline and no side visual
- alternating full-bleed sections, each making one point with one image or diagram
- generous vertical rhythm; section kickers numbered or labelled like chapters

**Must differ:** Hero is centred and type-only, and sections alternate full-bleed; siblings must not lead with a centred type-only hero.

directions.label: Product UI first
directions.summary: Show the product immediately: the interface itself is the hero and the argument.
directions.spec:
### Product UI first  `(id: product-ui-first)`

Show the product immediately: the interface itself is the hero and the argument.

**Cues:**
- a large, realistic product screenshot or device frame dominates the first screen, copy kept to one line plus an action
- annotated callouts pointing at real parts of the UI
- the key section is an interactive-looking walkthrough (tabs or steps), not marketing cards

**Must differ:** The first screen is dominated by a product UI with annotations; siblings must not make a product screenshot the dominant hero element.
